//: The player's choices about display and input. They are kept outside saves and no rule can read them. The engine acts on the ones named `theme` and `keymap` itself; playback reads `playback_speed` and `effects` (in playback.json), and cutscenes will read `cutscenes`.
name: Theme
doc: The theme every screen is drawn with: the qualified id of a `theme` definition. Changing it restyles every open screen.

name: Keys
doc: What each key means: the qualified id of a `keymap` definition.

name: Playback speed
doc: How fast what happened is played back: 1 is the usual pace, 2 is twice as fast, and 0 shows everything at once.

name: Cutscenes
doc: How often cutscenes play: all of them, only those of tier `major`, or none.
